terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Courtsie. By using our platform you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
body: Courtsie is a platform that connects players with sports venues (padel, tennis, basketball, football, volleyball, beach volley) and lets you book courts, create and join open games, and communicate with other members of the community.
We act as an intermediary. The sports venue itself is responsible for the availability, quality and delivery of its service.

sections.heading: Your account
body: Most features require an account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account.
You must provide accurate, truthful information. Creating an account on behalf of someone else without authorization is not permitted.

sections.heading: Bookings and cancellations
body: Each booking you complete is a commitment to the venue. Cancellation policies may vary by venue.
Courtsie does not guarantee court availability beyond what is shown at the time of booking. A venue owner may cancel a booking for reasons outside our control (e.g. weather, damage).

sections.heading: Community rules
body: You may not post or send content that is unlawful, abusive, threatening, misleading or offensive, and you may not harass other members.
We reserve the right to remove content and to suspend or delete accounts that violate these rules. You can report messages or users using the in-app tools.

sections.heading: Venue owners
body: As an owner, you are responsible for the accuracy of your venue details, prices, hours and availability. Venues are published after admin approval.
You agree to honour bookings made through the platform and to treat players with respect.

sections.heading: Liability
body: The service is provided "as is". To the maximum extent permitted by law, Courtsie is not liable for injuries, damages or losses arising from the use of sports facilities or from interaction with other members.
You are responsible for assessing whether any activity is suitable for your physical condition.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be announced within the platform. Continued use after a change means you accept the new terms.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any question about these terms, contact us at {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Courtsie processes when you use the iOS app or the website, why, on which legal basis, who we share it with, how long we keep it and what rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation 2016/679 (“GDPR”) and Greek Law 4624/2019.

sections.heading: Data controller and contact
body: The data controller is {controller}, operator of the Courtsie service.
For any question about your data, contact {email} or call {phone}. We reply within one month at the latest.

sections.heading: Data we collect
body: Account data: email, full name, role (player or venue owner) and password, which is stored only in hashed form.

Profile data: username (@handle), profile photo (optional), short bio (optional), playing level, language preference, number of matches played per sport and a rating based on reviews from other players.
Contact phone (optional): if you add it to your profile.
Bookings and games: court, date, time, duration, price, equipment, status (confirmed/cancelled) and participation in open games.

Community: followers and accounts you follow (and follow requests), posts (photos, captions, matches), stories that last 24 hours and who viewed them, likes, comments, messages and group chats, player reviews, blocked users and content reports.
In-app notifications (e.g. new booking, cancellation, friend request).
For venue owners: venue details (name, address, map location, photos, opening hours, prices, equipment) and bookings they enter themselves, which may include a customer's name and phone.
Technical data: IP address, device/browser type and server logs, needed to run and secure the service.

Location (optional): only if you use the “Distance to me” filter and grant permission. It is used only on your device to calculate distances to venues and is never sent to or stored on our servers. You can revoke the permission in your device settings.
We do not collect payment data, contacts or health data. Court payments are made directly at the venue.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis
body: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): creating and managing your account, bookings and cancellations, open games, messaging, booking notifications and account emails (sign-up confirmation, password reset).
Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): security of the service, fraud and abuse prevention, handling reports and moderating content, resolving booking disputes.

Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): appearing in community search (off by default, you turn it on), profile photo and contact phone. You can withdraw consent at any time by changing the setting or removing the data.
Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR): where the law or a competent authority requires us to keep or disclose data.
We do not use your data for advertising, we do not sell it and we do not track you across other companies' apps or websites. No automated decisions with significant effects are made about you.

sections.heading: Who can see your data
body: Other users: your name, @username, photo, bio, level, rating, number of matches and follower counts are visible to every signed-in user. Your posts, stories and follower lists are visible to all signed-in users if your account is public, or only to followers you approved if it is private. You appear in community search only if you enabled it. People you blocked cannot see your content. Your email is never shown to other users.
Venue owners: see bookings at their venues together with your name and profile. They see your phone number only while you have an active, confirmed upcoming booking at their venue.
Courtsie administrators: access data only as needed for support, venue approval and handling reports.

sections.heading: Service providers (processors)
body: Supabase Inc.: database, user authentication and photo storage.
Cloudflare, Inc.: hosting and running the application, protection against attacks.
Google LLC (Google Maps Platform): maps for venues. When you open a map, Google receives your IP address under its own privacy policy.
DeepL SE: automatic translation of venue names and areas. No personal user data is sent.
Email delivery provider: sends sign-up confirmation and password reset emails.
Apple: distributes the app through the App Store but has no access to your Courtsie account data.
All providers process data only on our instructions under data processing agreements (Art. 28 GDPR). Data may also be disclosed to public authorities where required by law.

sections.heading: Transfers outside the EEA
body: Some providers are based in the United States or may process data outside the European Economic Area. Such transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, with appropriate safeguards.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
body: For as long as your account is active.

When you delete your account, your account and profile data, photo, phone, posts, stories, likes, comments, followers, blocks, reviews, notifications and your membership in chats and open games are deleted immediately. Your upcoming bookings are cancelled. Stories stop being shown automatically after 24 hours.

Messages you already sent may remain in other people's conversations without your name or any link to you. Past bookings remain in the venue's history without your details, for accounting and tax purposes.
Content reports are kept for as long as needed to keep the community safe and to deal with repeated violations. Server logs are kept for a limited period by the hosting providers.

sections.heading: Deleting your account
body: You can permanently delete your account in the app: Profile → “Delete account” (venue owners: Settings → “Delete account”). You can also send a request to {email}.
If you are a venue owner, your venues are removed from the public list when your account is deleted.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 15–21 GDPR), and to withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.
You can correct most data yourself in your profile. For other requests email {email}. We may ask you to confirm your identity.
If you believe your rights are being violated, you can lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (1-3 Kifisias Ave., 115 23 Athens, www.dpa.gr).

sections.heading: Security
body: All communication is encrypted (HTTPS). Passwords are stored only in hashed form. Access to data is enforced at database level so each user sees only what they are entitled to, and administrative keys are kept on the server only, never in the app.
No system is perfectly secure. If we detect a breach that puts you at risk, we will inform you and the Authority as required by law.

sections.heading: Children
body: The service is intended for people aged 15 and over (Art. 21 of Greek Law 4624/2019). If you are a parent and believe a child under 15 created an account, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We only use strictly necessary storage on your device: to keep you signed in and to remember preferences such as language and theme.
We do not use advertising or analytics cookies and we do not track you across apps and websites.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy when the service or the law changes. The date of the last update is shown at the top. We will tell you about material changes in the app or by email.
